SELECT r.chat_room_idx AS chatRoomIdx,
-- 파일명 만들려고 같이 내려줌 r.user1_idx AS user1Idx, r.user2_idx AS user2Idx,
CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN r.user2_idx ELSE r.user1_idx END AS otherIdx,

r.last_message AS lastMessage, CAST(r.last_message_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS lastMessageAt,
CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN NVL(r.unread_count1,0) ELSE NVL(r.unread_count2,0) END AS unreadCount FROM chat_room r JOIN users u ON u.user_idx = CASE WHEN r.user1_idx = #{myIdx} THEN r.user2_idx ELSE r.user1_idx END WHERE #{myIdx} IN (r.user1_idx, r.user2_idx) ORDER BY r.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.chat_room_idx DESC
